title: Moroccan Chicken Tagine
description: A delicious and flavorful Moroccan chicken dish made with aromatic spices and sweet onions. Serve with crusty bread or couscous for a hearty meal.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the chicken thighs and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the aromatic spice blend, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add 1 cup of water to the pot and bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 20-25 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Stir in the sellou and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
